summary: Renders UI text with independent horizontal (a7) and vertical (a8) scale factors. Looks up the render context via SwitchBasedGlobalLookup(a6), temporarily scales two of its fields (at +92 and +96), applies a field setter at offset 0x48, divides the text position by the scale factors (truncated via CRTFtol), computes the aligned position using SizeComputationWithSubtraction (left, a5==1) or CenteredPosition (center, a5==2), draws through sub_553070 to the render device global dword_8B8DC8, then restores the context fields.

local_names.a2: horizontal position (divided by a7 and adjusted by alignment)
local_names.a6: render context / font id used for SwitchBasedGlobalLookup

operations.description: result = SwitchBasedGlobalLookup(a6): looks up the render context/font structure by id; returns null when absent.
If the looked-up context is null, return the null result immediately.
Save original context fields: v10 = *(float*)(context+92), v11 = *(int*)(context+96); then scale them in place: +92 = a7 * old, +96 = a8 * old.
FieldSetterAt0x48(a4): sets a field at offset 0x48 in a UI/render structure.
v13 = CRTFtol(a2 / a7); a2 = v13; a3 = CRTFtol(a3 / a8): divide position by the scale factors, truncating to integer.
If a5 == 1, SizeComputationWithSubtraction(a1, v13, &a2, a6): computes left-aligned text position.
Else if a5 == 2, CenteredPosition(a1, v13, &a2, a6): computes centered text position.
v13 = a2: adopt the alignment-adjusted horizontal position for rendering.
result = sub_553070(a1, v13, a3, dword_8B8DC8): draws the text to the render device.
Restore the original context fields: +92 = v14 (saved float), +96 = v15 (saved int).
